page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, full width. Printed page number "(8o)" at the head, centred. No running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: tium fingulorum capitum proponuntur: iis e-
nim intellectis & cognita verbi Perfecti con-
jugatione, facile erit formare Imperfectum:
nam ut minori hoc moleftia facias, omnino
confultum eft, ut quamlibet vocem verbi im-
perfecti ita formes, ac fi verbum perfectum
fit. Ita formata cum erit, facile videbis an
contra generales illas imperfectionis regulas,
aut fpeciales peccet. Videbunt in hifce ver-
bis ftudiofi quanti momenti fint aurei illi
appendicis primi libri Canones, quos ut hic
fæpe confulant & applicent rogatos eos volo.
Verbis cognitis, pergatur ad Nomina; & ab
his ad reliqua: de quibus nihil peculiare ha-
beo quod moneam; eft enim tractatus eo-
rum facilis. Rudimentis hifce totis lectis &
intellectis, exerceat fe ftudiofus in praxi
Grammatica iis annexa, locaque citata dili-
genter inquirat, ut omnia melius memoriæ in-
hæreant.
Praxi illā absolutā, in manus sumat Histo-
riam Josephi, ex Alchorano à me cum duplici
versione Latina & notis editam: singulas vo-
ces ad normam Grammatices diligenter exa-
minet, ut ego feci in ista praxi; notasque ad
difficiliores voces consulat, & semel atque ite-
rum egregii illius opusculi lectionem repetat;
certus id maximo fine fructu facturum se non
esse: nam & res Grammaticæ, & communio-
res quæque voces fœlicius memoriæ impri-
mentur.

page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout (e.g. "ftudiofi" read as studiosi, "eft" as est). Macrons on "illā" and "absolutā" read from the scan. The reference mark after "reliqua" is an apostrophe-like stroke, transcribed as nothing. Printing errors such as "Jofephi" (J as printed, spelling as Josephi) are left as printed in spelling apart from the s normalisation.
